AP1.label: Communication quality

AP1.1.label: Clear and accurate information delivery
AP1.1.description: Agent provided clear, complete, and correct information — a positive performance signal in this dimension.

AP1.2.label: Active listening and comprehension
AP1.2.description: Agent demonstrated understanding of the customer's issue by reflecting back accurately, asking relevant questions, and not asking for information already provided.

AP1.3.label: Appropriate tone and language
AP1.3.description: Agent's tone matched the context and customer's emotional state appropriately throughout.

AP1.4.label: Proactive communication of next steps
AP1.4.description: Agent proactively communicated timelines, next steps, and expectations without being asked.

AP1.5.label: Communication gap or confusion introduced
AP1.5.description: Agent's communication was unclear, confusing, or introduced ambiguity — a negative signal.

AP1.description: How clearly, accurately, and appropriately the agent communicated throughout the interaction.

AP2.label: Problem-solving effectiveness

AP2.1.label: Correctly diagnosed the root issue
AP2.1.description: Agent accurately identified the underlying cause of the customer's problem.

AP2.2.label: Applied correct and effective resolution
AP2.2.description: Agent used the right tool, process, or action to resolve the issue.

AP2.3.label: Offered alternatives when primary solution unavailable
AP2.3.description: When the ideal resolution was not possible, agent proactively offered the next best option.

AP2.4.label: Escalated appropriately when required
AP2.4.description: Agent recognised when the issue exceeded their authority or capability and escalated correctly.

AP2.5.label: Missed diagnosis or applied wrong solution
AP2.5.description: Agent misidentified the issue or applied a resolution that did not address the root cause.

AP2.description: How effectively the agent diagnosed and resolved the customer's issue.

AP3.label: Empathy and rapport

AP3.1.label: Proactively acknowledged customer frustration
AP3.1.description: Agent noticed and explicitly acknowledged the customer's emotional state before being asked.

AP3.2.label: Personalised the interaction
AP3.2.description: Agent adapted to the individual customer rather than delivering a scripted or generic response.

AP3.3.label: Appropriate apology when warranted
AP3.3.description: Agent apologised sincerely and appropriately when an error or inconvenience occurred.

AP3.4.label: Failed to acknowledge customer emotion
AP3.4.description: Agent did not acknowledge the customer's expressed frustration, distress, or dissatisfaction.

AP3.description: Whether the agent acknowledged the customer's emotional state and made them feel heard and valued.

AP4.label: Technical knowledge and accuracy

AP4.1.label: Demonstrated strong product or service knowledge
AP4.1.description: Agent showed depth of knowledge about the product, feature, or process relevant to the issue.

AP4.2.label: Used tools and systems effectively
AP4.2.description: Agent used the available systems, lookup tools, or internal resources correctly and efficiently.

AP4.3.label: Provided inaccurate or misleading information
AP4.3.description: Agent gave incorrect information about the product, policy, or process — a negative signal.

AP4.4.label: Lacked knowledge and could not assist
AP4.4.description: Agent was unable to answer the customer's question and did not know how to find the answer.

AP4.description: The depth and accuracy of the agent's product knowledge and technical understanding.

AP5.label: Process adherence

AP5.1.label: Followed standard procedures correctly
AP5.1.description: Agent completed all required steps in the correct order per company process.

AP5.2.label: Documented the case correctly
AP5.2.description: Agent captured case notes, resolution steps, and relevant details accurately.

AP5.3.label: Deviated from required process
AP5.3.description: Agent skipped steps, applied shortcuts, or deviated from required procedure — a negative signal.

AP5.4.label: Failed to obtain required authorisation
AP5.4.description: Agent took an action that required manager or policy approval without obtaining it.

AP5.description: Whether the agent followed required procedures, policies, and quality standards.
